scientific_integrity: Analytical algebraic transposition proof covers the stated continuous parameter range; the reproducible finite rational checker is corroboration, not a proof. Priority remains provisional against incompletely accessible older sources and more general rearrangement results.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for an idealized one-state light induction model with fixed multiset of unequal light durations, equal dark gaps, constant light intensity, and zero post-pulse reward; no result for arbitrary more than four lightflecks or four with nonzero initial induction. It has no plant-level empirical validation.
title: Four-sunfleck pendulum ordering and a three-sunfleck pre-induction switch
